CustomField.description: The applicant's answer on a reciprocity application to whether their out-of-state license is one of the types the Board does not accept from any state: Hairdressing, Hairstyling, Hair Design, Hairdresser, Hairdresser/Cosmetologist, Hairdressing and Manicuring, Cosmetician, Class CA, Class CH, or a Florida nail, facial or full specialist license. A Yes stops the application, so saved applications show No.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set by the applicant on the portal. Yes means the license type cannot be transferred to Louisiana.
CustomField.label: Non-Transferable License Type
